Description.header: Search RAG collections directly through ChromaDB
Description.body: Embeds search and queries every ChromaDB collection whose name matches collection_use_regex and does not match collection_avoid_regex. No LLM or agent pipeline is used. score_min and score_max are inclusive bounds on the raw Chroma distance, where smaller values are closer matches; the defaults accept distances from 0.0 through 1.0. count is the maximum number of results after all matching collections are merged by ascending distance. collection_use_regex defaults to every collection and an empty collection_avoid_regex excludes none. Returned document content is resolved from authoritative filesystem storage through the document dispatcher after Chroma returns matching chunk IDs.
Description.footer: The response is JSON with error_code, selected collections, score semantics, and a documents array containing collection, id, score, and content.
